rows.en: Yeah, maybe I am.
Heh, no doubt about it.
(Alto really does love the sky.)
(Looks like Saotome-kun's up on the roof again...)
Saotome-kun, you're here again?
rows.notes: Shared by the female rooftop (frd_alt_001) and library (frd_alt_002) scenes; 'here' fits both.

rows.en: You really love it, don't you...
Yeah, maybe I am.
(Saotome-kun really does love the sky.)
(Alto said he'd be in the library.)
Hey, Alto. What are you reading?
Yeah...
rows.notes: Absent-minded reply; also used in scd_fes_908 ('Yeah...' as he agrees).

rows.en: You seem really into it. Is it any good?

(He's not lost in thought... is he?
Or he just can't be bothered with me?)
(Okay. If that's how it's gonna be...)
Hm, huh? What's this?
'A Genius in Female Roles: The World of Kabuki'...?
rows.notes: Book title; onnagata (kabuki actor of female roles) rendered 'genius in female roles', as the earlier campus lines and Alto's profile describe it.

rows.en:
'A splendid lineage, rare talent and beauty...
And now that figure dances across Frontier.'
Urk!
'Alto Saotome in Action: A Photo Coll...'
rows.notes: Title cut off mid-word (the Japanese breaks off inside 'photo collection'); kept unfinished.

rows.en:
Ahh, ahh!
\p!
What brings you here?

Oh, nothing, just a book that caught my eye.
Seems there's this gorgeous kabuki actor
who plays female roles named Saotome...
Nngh, okay, okay! I'm sorry I ignored you!

Well, whatever.
So what were you looking at so intently?
Yeah, it's this here...
'Mother Sky'... A photo book of the sky...?

Yeah. Somehow, when I look through this,
it feels like I'm up on the roof watching the sky.

I see. So that's why your head was
in the clouds.

Well, part of it was that I just plain
couldn't be bothered.
Hey, come on...
(Saotome-kun said he'd be at the library.)
Hey, Saotome-kun, what are you reading?
You seem really into it. Is it interesting?

(He's not lost in thought... is he?
Maybe he just can't be bothered with me?)
(Hmm, if that's how it's gonna be...)
Hm, huh? What's this?

'A Genius in Female Roles: The World of Kabuki'...
it says?

Oh, nothing, just a book that caught my eye.
Seems there's this gorgeous kabuki actor
who plays female roles named Saotome...

As long as you get it.
So what were you looking at so intently?
'Mother Sky'... A photo book of the sky, huh?

I see. So that's why your head was
in the clouds.
Hey, that's mean!
(Looks like Alto's in the library again...)
Yeah, I got the urge to look at that thing again.
You must really like it.
Hm? \p, you're still here?

Huh?! That's harsh.
I'll go get "that" book again!
rows.notes: 'That' = the kabuki book about Alto from the first library scene; 'book' added so the threat reads.

rows.en:
Sorry, I was kidding.
Anything but that, please...

(Alto's head is always in the clouds
when he looks at that book...)
(Looks like Saotome-kun's in the library again...)
You must really like it.

Huh?! That's so mean!
I'll go get "that" book again!

(Saotome-kun's head is always in the clouds
when he looks at that book...)

(Okay, I made plans with Alto today, didn't I...
Where should we go...?)
Hey. Sorry to keep you waiting.

Hey, Alto.
How about tea at "Silver Moon" today?
You were going to tell me something last time, right?
rows.notes: Silver Moon is provisional in locations.json.

rows.en:
Hm? Oh, yeah, that's right.
Let's get going, then.

Phew, this place sure is popular
with Mihoshi students.

Yeah, there are lots of familiar faces here,
even on a day off.
It's kinda...
rows.notes: Also the female player in nml_alt_012 (girls squealing over Alto); trailing 'It's kinda...' fits both.

rows.en: What's wrong?

Well, it kinda feels like all the girls
are staring over here...

You think?
Aren't you being a little self-conscious?
(I'm pretty sure it's Alto they're staring at, though...)

Keep worrying about girls that much,
and you'll end up like Michael.
rows.notes: Alto says the full name Mihaeru here, so 'Michael' (Michel only where the Japanese has Mishieru).

rows.en: Hahaha...
Geez.

By the way, that "thing you wanted to ask"
you mentioned before... what was it?
Hm? Oh, yeah, right.

I wanted to ask you, "Why'd you join
the Pilot Course?"
Huh?! That's it?
What do you mean, "that's it"?!

Well, you said you had "something to ask,"
so I figured it was something more serious...

Hm... Ah, I see. Yeah.
Now that you mention it... maybe you're right...

Right? For something you made such
a point of asking...
rows.notes: Literally 'though for something you'd ask so formally...'; the player means the question was trivial for such a build-up.

rows.en:
Never mind.
So, what's your answer?
Hmm, let's see. I think it was...
...and that's about it.
rows.notes: The player's actual answer is skipped by the script (time cut between rows).

rows.en: I see. So you really thought it through.
So what about you, Alto?
Ngh... W-well, never mind about me...

uncertain: c03822: uses Silver Moon (provisional in locations.json).
c03783/c03803: book title for tensai onnagata rendered 'A Genius in Female Roles: The World of Kabuki' (no glossary term for onnagata; earlier campus rows say 'genius of female roles').
c03784/c03786: in-world book blurb and the cut-off title 'Alto Saotome in Action: A Photo Coll...' (Japanese breaks off mid-word).
c03841: 'aratamete kiku ni shite wa' read as 'for something you made such a point of asking' (the question was trivial for the build-up).
